findings.motion: H. 4000 on adoption of amendment #556 (roll call No. 30; 25 yeas, 132 nays)
findings.note: Roll call page lists Sousa with N (a no vote) on amendment 556, which was rejected. The Beacon Hill Roll Call report for April 28 - May 2, 2025 (https://wcatwakefield.org/4282-2) describes a rejected H 4000 amendment on the same day, 25 yeas, which would require voters to present valid identification such as a driver's license or passport and have the Secretary of State create a free photo ID card program for voting; it reports 131 no votes where the official roll call shows 132, and the roll call page itself does not state the amendment's subject.
